## Universal Corporation Appoints John Ament as President of Universal Ingredients


November 23, 2026


*Ament Brings More Than 30 Years of Global Leadership Experience Across the Food, Consumer Goods, and Agriculture Industries*


RICHMOND, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV) (“Universal” or the “Company”), a global business-to-business agriproducts company, today announced the appointment of John Ament as President of Universal Ingredients, effective December 7, 2026.


In this role, Ament will lead the Ingredients business, overseeing its strategy, operations, and financial performance. He will focus on strengthening commercial execution, expanding customer relationships, and building organizational capabilities to support long-term growth.


“John brings the strategic vision and leadership experience needed to accelerate innovation and value creation at Universal Ingredients,” said Preston Wigner, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of Universal Corporation. “Throughout his career, John has proven his ability to lead complex global businesses, develop high-performing teams and strong customer relationships, and drive performance. I look forward to working closely with John.”


“I look forward to joining Universal Ingredients at an important point in its evolution,” said Ament. “The business has strong capabilities, talented teams, and meaningful opportunities ahead. Working with our Ingredients teams and customers, we will build on those strengths and shape the next chapter for the business.”


Ament brings more than three decades of international leadership experience across the consumer goods, food, and agricultural industries spanning four continents. He spent nearly 30 years with Mars, Incorporated, where he held increasingly senior roles. As President of Mars Chocolate Latin America, he oversaw the company’s regional business, including the acquisition of Chocolates Turín and the integration of the Mars Chocolate and Wrigley Confectionary operations. As Global Vice President, Cocoa, he led the company’s global cocoa operations, including sourcing, processing, research and development, and sustainability. He then served as Principal Partner of the RRG Regenerative Fund and Managing Director of RRG Nature Based Solutions at Renewable Resources Group, where he managed strategic account relationships with consumer product companies. Most recently, he served as Vice President, Global Strategic Accounts at Ball Corporation (NYSE:BALL), where he led global relationships and negotiations with two of the company’s key beverage customers.


Ament holds a doctorate in veterinary medicine from the University of São Paulo and has completed executive leadership and international business programs at Harvard Business School, the University of Oxford’s Saïd Business School, and London Business School.


**About Universal Corporation**


Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV) is a global agricultural company with over 100 years of experience supplying products and innovative solutions to meet its customers’ evolving needs and precise specifications. Through its diverse network of farmers and partners across more than 30 countries on five continents, Universal is a trusted provider of high-quality, traceable products. Leveraging extensive supply chain expertise, global reach, integrated processing capabilities, and a commitment to sustainability, Universal provides a range of products and services designed to drive efficiency and deliver value to its customers. For more information, visit[www.universalcorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.universalcorp.com&esheet=54645855&newsitemid=20261123606380&lan=en-US&anchor=www.universalcorp.com&index=1&md5=0d385890462d0b4fb7c2e3c4fdf6397a) .


**About Universal Ingredients**


Universal Ingredients, Inc., a subsidiary of Universal Corporation, is a plant-based ingredient solutions company that provides its customers with a broad variety of plant-based ingredients for both human and pet consumption. Through global sourcing, value-added manufacturing processes, product development, and custom formulation capabilities, Universal Ingredients converts plant-based raw materials into a broad portfolio of fruit and vegetable ingredients, dehydrated vegetables, fruits, herbs and spices, flavors, botanical extracts, and beverage systems that meet its customers’ evolving needs.
